name: Sculptor
tagline: Desktop app from Imbue for running coding agents in parallel, each in an isolated workspace.
description: Sculptor runs each agent in its own workspace with a branch, terminal, and diff view, and can move an agent's changes into your local repo for testing. It is MIT-licensed, ships for macOS and Linux, and is described by Imbue as an experimental research preview.

pricing.notes: Free and open source under MIT; model usage is billed by your own provider.
